title: Red River National Wildlife Refuge Boundary Modification Act
official_summary:
Red River National Wildlife Refuge Boundary Modification Act

This bill modifies the boundary of the Red River National Wildlife Refuge in Louisiana.

summary.headline: A 2022 law that changes the boundary of the Red River National Wildlife Refuge in Louisiana.
summary.what_it_does: The law changes the edges of the Red River National Wildlife Refuge in Louisiana. The official summary does not say which lands are added or removed, or what rules apply to them. Reading the full bill text would give those details.

who_it_affects.group: Landowners and land users near or inside the refuge
who_it_affects.how: People whose property sits in the area whose boundary changed may be affected, but the summary does not say how.

summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted December 27, 2022. The summary does not state a separate effective date.
